station_name: Lost Creek near Clipper Mills, Calif.
notes: Digitized table covers the daily grid and the monthly summary below it. Measurements = daily values, counted by month (31+30+31+31+28+31+30+31+30+31+31+30 = 365, no blank days). Summary values: 12 months x 5 columns (second-foot-days, maximum, minimum, mean, run-off) = 60, plus calendar year 1938 row 5 and water year row 5 = 70. Other distances printed: 1,000 feet downstream from Lost Creek Dam and 2 miles north of town of Clipper Mills. Peak discharge line below the table not counted.
